_comment: 🔮️ This owner's contribution to the repository test platform: the third-party references its own laws judge against.

oracles.rationale: Judges the tool machine in `🧪️tests/🧪️conformance` (design §5): every `🧫️transaction-law` chart built as an xstate machine against the TypeScript reducer, id minting and runner; in `🧪️tests/🧪️gesture-drive-law` the window's gesture slot (idle, open, unrestorable) as an xstate machine against `driveGesture` on every fixture row and random sequence, and against the per-window `GestureLedger` on every slot scenario and host fact.

Generates random yield sequences for the transaction law in `🧪️tests/🧪️conformance` and random dispatch sequences (verbs, phases, ticks, moved bases, unrestorable gestures) for the gesture-drive law in `🧪️tests/🧪️gesture-drive-law`; runner and xstate oracle must agree at every step.
